8.4.3. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.area.createArea¶

iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.area.createArea(subtype, name, nodes=None, edges=None)¶

Convenience function to create an area.

The end-point nodes for edges are inferred and do not need to be contained in nodes as well.

Parameters:
  • subtype (str) – The usertype of the area to be created.
  • name (str) – The name of the area to be created.
  • nodes (Iterable(INode) | none) – The collection of (isolated) nodes. None means the empty set, which is the default to nodes.
  • edges (Iterable(IEdge) | none) – The collection of edges. None means the empty set. End-points of edges do not need to be members in nodes; they are inferred.
Return type:

IGraph
Returns:

The created area.
